sentences.text: In short: FLIKKFLAKK INVEST AS is an established company based in Oslo, profitable in 2025.

According to the register, the registered activity of FLIKKFLAKK INVEST AS is "Investeringer i aksjer, verdipapirer og fast eiendom, forvaltning, kjøp og salg av fast eiendom og annet som faller naturlig sammen med dette.".
FLIKKFLAKK INVEST AS is a private limited company (AS), founded on 2020-04-04, registered in Oslo.
It an operating loss of NOK 7,516 (2025).
Its 2025 accounts show a strong equity ratio of 63% of total assets.
The annual result was a profit in each of the 3 filed years read (2023: NOK 635,005, 2024: NOK 130,666, 2025: NOK 125,648).
FLIKKFLAKK INVEST AS is led by board chair Joachim Hanche-Olsen.
The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2026-10-08 (within the past year).
